stem.text: Which reaction would **not** give ethanoic acid?

A.text: heating ethanenitrile under reflux with dilute sodium hydroxide

B.text: heating ethanenitrile under reflux with dilute sulfuric acid

C.text: heating ethanal under reflux with acidified sodium dichromate(VI)
